cause: Maynard had a dedicated building and scenery pass; the other towns used generic world buildings and ground.
changes: Reuse Maynard shop signs, facade shading, shadows, glowing windows and smith smoke.
Connect all Quizilog shop approaches with warm stone lanes, preserving blocked palms; add trade props and desert planting.
Connect Ervyn shops and its eastern road with a garden loop, flowers, shrubs and butterflies.
Show new paving in area maps and select stone footsteps; cover props and shadows in unexplored cells.

verification.test_maintenance: Updated the older mountain color assertion to accept the existing approved SnowPalette while retaining binary alpha and contour checks. No mountain artwork changed for this task.

capture: Isolated fixtures; actual native game rendering at 2x nearest-neighbor scale, no post-processing. GIFs contain 32 frames sampled at 8 fps.
preservation: No core map, collision, quest, encounter, save-format or personal-save edits. Local builds only; no package generated.
